API_ID.description: The numeric **App api_id** from https://my.telegram.org (API development tools), usually 7-8 digits. It is NOT your Telegram user id and NOT the number in front of the colon in the bot token.

API_HASH.description: The 32-character **App api_hash** from https://my.telegram.org (API development tools).

BIN_CHANNEL.description: ID of a PRIVATE Telegram channel used as file storage, like -100123456789. Add your bot to it as ADMIN first.
